items.what: The label of the practice-area filter button a visitor clicks on the case results list
items.where: Not saved by this website. It is handed to the site's analytics tag in the visitor's browser.
items.kept: Not kept by this plugin. How long Google keeps it depends on the site's Google account settings.
items.shared: Google Analytics or Google Tag Manager, through the Scout Analytics plugin
items.when: Only when the Scout Analytics plugin is installed and its tag is on the page.

notes: Case results are written by site staff. The plugin has no form and saves nothing about visitors.
